title: Finite-cover descent of the external section comparison
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite open cover of $Y$. Assume the explicit external tensor comparison [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] is bijective for $(X,U_i,F,G|_{U_i})$ and for $(X,U_i\cap U_j,F,G|_{U_i\cap U_j})$, with the induced structure maps. Then the external tensor comparison for $(X,Y,F,G)$ is bijective. No quasi-coherence or affineness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech; degree-zero finite-cover argument

proof.text: Identify X times V for an open V in Y with the inverse image of V under the second projection. Open-immersion pullback/restriction and composition of adjunctions identify the restricted external coefficient with that formed with G restricted to V. Their unit equations identify restricted pure external tensors. Tensor induction gives compatibility for all tensors.

Form the sheaf equalizers for G on U_i and the external coefficient on the inverse-image cover. Tensoring the first with Gamma(X,F) preserves its kernel and both finite products over k. The compatibility from step 1 gives a diagram whose chart and overlap comparisons are bijective by hypothesis. Restrict their commuting inverses to the equalizers to get the inverse to the canonical global comparison. This includes empty covers, empty overlaps, and zero coefficients.

lean.statement:
theorem externalGlobalSectionsTensor_bijective_of_finite_cover
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] (U : ι → Y.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hU : ∀ i, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f ((U i).ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict (U i).ι)))
    (hUU : ∀ i j, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f ((U i ⊓ U j).ι ≫ g) F
        (G.restrict (U i ⊓ U j).ι))) :
    Function.Bijective (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f g F G)
